_comment: Exam-adequacy rules the gap-check step evaluates. `severity: blocking` means the report withholds a final rating (provisional only) until the gap is cured. Each rule cites authority ids from authorities.json. The predicate for each rule is implemented in steps/gap_check.py under the same id.

rules.description: Pain on passive range of motion was not tested and the examiner gave no reason it could not be done.
Pain with weight-bearing and/or nonweight-bearing was not documented.
The opposite joint is undamaged but its range of motion was not measured for comparison.
Repetitive-use testing was not performed and no reason was given.
Flare-ups were reported but the examiner neither estimated functional loss during flares (in degrees where possible) nor explained why an estimate could not be given.
Pain on motion was noted but the examiner did not state whether it causes functional loss.
A medical opinion was given without a reasoned rationale, or declined as speculative without explaining why.
Persistent instability was found but the examiner did not document whether a medical provider has prescribed bracing and/or an assistive device for ambulation, which the DC 5257 criteria turn on.
